title: The AI Evolution: Mario Rodriguez, GitHub
talk_summary: A GitHub VP product talk about Copilot's history and future vision, mostly marketing and roadmap speculation.

takeaways.what_they_do: Maintain separate offline evaluation suites and online/production scorecards, and expect them to diverge; use both to iterate quickly at scale.
takeaways.evidence_quote: in your offline evals everything's working, you go to prod and your online evals kind of tank. So, be ready for that.

takeaways.what_they_do: Use scorecards as the mechanism to compare quality across iterations so shipping speed can increase without silent regressions.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Score cards are very very helpful because what sometimes works in offline is not really going to work in online.

takeaways.technique: Treat prompt engineering as real engineering
takeaways.what_they_do: Claims prompt quality is a genuine, hard skill distinct from demo-building, and that it materially affects product usability.
takeaways.evidence_quote: prompt engineering is a very true thing... I could create a demo for you all probably within 30 seconds. Making AI product that actually gets used... takes a lot of hard work.
